In fervent fervor, I fervently pray,
That fiery fervor won't fan the flames of disarray.
I yearn to spark, a spark within your breast,
A flame that flickers, with fervent, fervent quest.

I don't want to set, the world on fire's blaze,
But kindle kindness, in your compassionate ways.
I long to ignite, a love that's strong and free,
A flame that flickers, with fervent ecstasy.

In fervent fervor, I fervently implore,
That you would feel, the fervent love I store.
I don't want to fan, the flames of strife and pain,
But fan the flames, of faith, and fervent love's sweet gain.
